---
name: Platform access offer
about: Offer (or point us to) a system the benchmark could run on
labels: platform-access, help wanted
---

**Platform:** (LinuxONE / Linux on Z / z/OS / x86 server; machine generation, e.g. z16, z17, Xeon 4th Gen)

**Capacity:** (core or IFL count, dedicated or shared, SMT, memory)

**Terms:** does the platform's terms of use allow performance testing *and* publishing results? (yes / with written permission / unsure; link if public)

**Window:** (dates or times available, maximum load or duration)

**Constraints:** (anything we must not do, how to ask us to stop)

**May we acknowledge you by name?** (yes / no)

Please don't post credentials or internal hostnames here. Details are arranged through this issue first; for
anything that should not be public (contacts, terms you cannot share publicly, network details), the maintainer
replies here with a private contact.
